findings.title: ShinyHunters: Cyber Criminal Group Attacks Learning Management System (FBI/IC3 PSA260515)
findings.summary_md: FBI/IC3 advisory I-051526-PSA, dated 15 May 2026, describes ShinyHunters as a criminal group behind a Learning Management System attack and large-scale data theft and extortion. It states SH actors use harassment of victims and their families, swatting, and false claims of possessing compromising material, and have posted stolen data to Tor-hosted leak sites. This is the advisory ShinyHunters' September leak-site post demands be removed.

findings.title: 'We Hacked the FBI:' Hackers Say They Have Data on All FBI Employees
findings.summary_md: Joseph Cox reported a ShinyHunters representative claiming data on all FBI employees and applicants, with a sample of 5,000 alleged agents including names, home addresses, phone numbers and spouse details seen by 404 Media. The article notes criminals from the same ecosystem previously used stolen telecom data to track and harass FBI agents, and that the data would aid foreign intelligence services.

findings.title: High profile hacking group claims it hacked the FBI and stole data on employees
findings.summary_md: The National News Desk reported the FBIjobs.gov defacement reading 'this site has been seized by ShinyHunters' and a 'System Unavailable' state on September 22, plus the group's statement that PII and PHI on incumbent and former employees and all applicant information was compromised. A group representative described the operation as coercion rather than extortion. The FBI had not responded at publication.

findings.title: Exclusive: Hacked FBI data has sensitive information about employees' intelligence roles
findings.summary_md: Reuters examined a 5,000-line spreadsheet said by the hackers to be a small piece of a claimed two to three terabyte trove. It lists names, addresses, phone numbers, dates of birth, Social Security numbers and emergency contacts, plus assignments to specific field offices and units doing intelligence, security or counterespionage work.

findings.title: ShinyHunters claims FBI breach was revenge for 'false' report
findings.summary_md: Analysis of the ShinyHunters leak-site PSA addressed to FBI Cyber Division Assistant Director Brett Leatherman and Director Kash Patel, demanding removal of the Q2 2026 FLASH report within one week and claiming compromise of Criminal Justice, HR and Medlink services. The post identifies the grievance target as the FBI/IC3 PSA260515 issued May 15, 2026, and cites 404 Media's verification of a roughly 5,000-agent sample.

findings.title: ShinyHunters hackers say they stole psychiatric and medical records of FBI staff
findings.summary_md: Reuters reported that FBI personnel data stolen by ShinyHunters includes sensitive psychiatric and medical evaluation records, according to the hackers and documents reviewed by Reuters. This extended the known exposure beyond identity and staffing data to protected health information, two days before the story was picked up by the tracked feed.
